Taxes.opportunitiesDisclaimer: General information, not tax advice, and not a claim that your business qualifies. Eligibility, limits and timing change by year and by state, and your accountant confirms all three.
Taxes.topic_section179_body: Equipment, vehicles and off-the-shelf software can sometimes be deducted in the year they go into service instead of over time. Ask: does anything we bought this year qualify?
Taxes.topic_bonusDepreciation_body: A separate allowance that can apply to qualifying assets, sometimes alongside Section 179. Ask: which of the two is better for us this year?
Taxes.topic_qbi_body: Pass-through businesses may deduct part of their qualified income. Ask: does our entity type and income level put this in reach?
Taxes.topic_retirement_body: A SEP-IRA, SIMPLE or solo 401(k) can lower taxable income while paying you or your staff. Ask: what could we still contribute before the deadline?
Taxes.topic_homeOffice_body: Space used regularly and exclusively for the business may be deductible. Ask: do we track the square footage and the utilities?
Taxes.topic_vehicle_body: Mileage or actual costs, whichever serves you better — but only with records kept through the year. Ask: are we logging trips well enough to claim it?

Help.title: Help & support
Help.lede: How the portal works, and how to reach your accountant.
Help.q1: Where do the numbers come from?
Help.a1: Every figure comes from a document your accountant published: a Profit & Loss, a Balance Sheet, a bank statement or a tax record. Revenue and net income come only from the Profit & Loss; your expenses come from the debits on your published bank statements. Nothing is estimated unless it is labelled that way.
Help.a2: When Hoyos Baker finishes reviewing and reconciling a document, it is published and shows up on your Overview, in the statements and in the reports library. Until then it stays with the firm.
Help.a3: Nick explains your published figures, compares periods, lists reminders and can prepare a download or a CSV export after you confirm. Every number Nick states carries a source chip you can click. Nick is not a substitute for your accountant and gives no legal, tax or investment advice.
Help.q4: How do I download an original document?
Help.a4: Use Download Reports on the Overview, the download button on a statement, the reports library, or ask Nick. Every download serves the exact original file through a link that is valid for one minute.
Help.a5: Your accountant at Hoyos Baker, through the channel you already use. Mention the business name and the period you are asking about, and they will see the same screens you do.
Help.q6: Why do my expenses not match my Profit & Loss?
Help.a6: They measure different things. The Expenses page adds up money that actually left your bank accounts; the Profit & Loss records expenses in the period they belong to, whether or not they were paid then. Both are correct — they answer different questions, so the portal never merges them.
Help.q7: Why can't I see totals for some periods?
Help.a7: Totals only appear when published bank statements cover the whole period for every account. If a month is missing, the portal says so instead of treating those days as zero and quietly understating your spending.
Help.q8: What does "Firm confirmed" mean on a tax figure?
Help.a8: It means your accountant has checked and stands behind that amount. Anything marked Estimated, Payable or Pending review may still change — nothing is presented as final until they confirm it.
Help.q9: How do I get a copy of my data, or close my account?
Help.a9: Settings → Data & privacy. Both are requests your accountant reviews: accounting records have to be kept for a legally required period, so a deletion request closes your access rather than erasing the firm's books, and nothing happens until they confirm with you.
Help.conversationsBody: Conversations are private to you: neither other members of the business nor the firm can read them. You can delete a conversation at any time from the Ask Nick page.
